art_instructions: Compose a cozy cottage exterior in bright sun: creamy white walls, terracotta roof, and soft sage-green shutters, with a matching sage-green front door on a small porch with two low steps and a stone foundation. Set a curved cobblestone path entering from the bottom edge toward the porch; plant tall sunflowers to the left of the door and a lavender patch to the right for continuity with earlier home scenes. The door stands ajar, opening inward, revealing a warm, dim interior glow and the hint of a simple rug, but no interior details or text. Place the owl in the foreground at child eye level, about 35% of frame height, on the right side of the steps, angled three-quarters left toward the doorway. She has mottled brown-and-cream feathers, large round amber eyes, a small green scarf tied at her neck, and a tiny satchel slung across her body. Pose her mid-entry: one foot on the threshold and the other lifted in a gentle step, wings slightly spread for balance, head turned back toward the viewer with a small happy smile. Keep the background simple and airy with a pale blue sky and soft garden shapes; add a terracotta flower pot on the porch rail for balance. Lighting is diffuse top-front with minimal soft cel-shade; cast a light shadow beneath the owl and under the porch eaves for clarity.
